$comment: Contract between infrastructure inventory owners and Kubernetes topology publication. Validate before mutating Node labels.
title: GPU topology inventory contract
description: Normalized, versioned topology facts with per-field provenance for every schedulable GPU node.

$schema.description: Connects this JSON document to its local machine-readable documentation and validation contract.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this inventory contract, not the Kubernetes or hardware version.

generatedAt.description: UTC timestamp when this normalized inventory snapshot was produced; operators use it to detect stale topology data.

nodes.description: One normalized record for every Kubernetes worker that may participate in GPU scheduling.

name.description: Exact Kubernetes Node metadata.name to which the normalized topology facts will be published.

block.description: Coarse fabric domain containing multiple leaf switches; this is the wider TAS fallback boundary in the lab.

leaf.description: Leaf-switch domain to which the worker NIC is connected; same-leaf placement is the preferred fast network locality demonstrated in the lab.

rack.description: Physical rack identifier, retained as an operational location fact even though the live TAS hierarchy uses block, leaf, and hostname.

nic.description: Node network-interface identifier, such as the ConnectX interface mlx5_0 used for high-speed fabric traffic.

gpuSku.description: Normalized accelerator model or capacity class. h100-sxm5 means an NVIDIA H100 SXM5-class GPU node; the laptop lab still uses fake capacity, not real hardware.

sources.description: Per-field provenance: the authoritative system or discovery mechanism that supplied each topology fact.

rack.description: Authority for rack placement; the sample uses NetBox/DCIM.

leaf.description: Authority for switch adjacency; the sample combines LLDP discovery with the fabric-management API.

gpuSku.description: Authority for GPU model discovery; the sample uses NVIDIA GPU Operator data.

numa.description: Authority for node-local NUMA topology; the sample names kubelet/device discovery.
